title: UI: Stage zoom controls (zoom in/out/percentage)
description: Add stage zoom controls to Shell.tsx. The stage area should support: Ctrl+= zoom in, Ctrl+- zoom out, Ctrl+0 fit to window. Add a zoom percentage dropdown/input in the toolbar area above the stage (e.g. 25%, 50%, 100%, 200%, 400%). The stage already has a zoom/pan system (check StageArea.tsx for zoomLevel prop or similar). Wire the zoom state to show the percentage and allow user input. Build must pass.
